label: Roof launcher trooper
note: One of the two seeker launcher troopers on the barracks hall roof at the home port (the west and east roof posts, port_round.json). A roof rifleman with the seeker launcher over his shoulder instead of the rifle ('launcher': NpcLauncher and content/core/weapons/npc_seeker.json): your ship off the ground in town is hostile to the garrison (ShipPilot.hostile_in_town), so as it lifts off he locks on and fires seekers at it, and your cockpit's seeker warning sounds. On foot he lobs slow seekers at you.
